The climate in Kyiv

Kyiv is about 160 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 27°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −5°C. Around 610 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in July (about 69 mm). The highest temperature in Kyiv in 2015–2024 was 36°C (14 July 2024) and the lowest −23°C (19 February 2021).

Best time to visit Kyiv

The most pleasant weather in Kyiv is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 21°C and 27°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month. In January and February nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
